title: Reconstruct Itinerary
description: Given a list of airline tickets, reconstruct the itinerary starting from 'JFK' using all tickets exactly once in lexicographical order.
pseudocode:
1. Build adjacency list of sorted destinations
2. Define DFS function(airport)
3. While adj[airport] has destinations: pop next dest, DFS(next)
4. Add airport to result list after visiting all neighbors
5. Reverse result list

steps.note: Built adjacency list: {JFK: [ATL, SFO], ATL: [SFO], SFO: [ATL]}
Backtrack from ATL, add to path
Backtrack from SFO, add to path
Backtrack from ATL, add to path
Backtrack from JFK, add to path
Reverse path: [JFK, ATL, SFO, ATL, SFO, ATL, JFK]
